task.title: Roll back a migration
task.shortdesc: A migration changes files in a pull request, so you roll it back the way you roll back any change.

step.cmd: Revert the migration's pull request in the documentation repository.
Remove the redirect file the migration added, if it was published.

info.p: Old URLs then resolve to the DITA-OT site again.

step.cmd: If an approved rule caused the problem, reject it so the next run doesn't use it.
